items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of beach fire permit
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Widerspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Behörde: Amt Musterschlei, Am Markt 6, 24376 Musterkappeln.
items.computation: Letter dated and presumably posted 18.11.2026 (Wed); no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' given, so posting day = letter date. Delivery fiction per letter itself and § 110 Abs. 2 LVwG: 4th day after posting, counting 19,20,21,22 Nov → 22.11.2026 (Sunday). This is a general authority (Ordnungsamt), not a Finanzamt, so unlike tax law the delivery day is NOT shifted for falling on a Sunday (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG/LVwG analogue – only period ends move, not the delivery day). So Bekanntgabe = 22.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period (§ 70 VwGO / general administrative law, mirrored by the letter's own Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung): day of delivery not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), period ends on the day in the following month with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) → 22.12.2026. That day is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Final day to lodge Widerspruch: 22.12.2026.
